Rahul Gandhi’s US remarks spark BJP backlash and political debate

During a visit to the United States, Rahul Gandhi said India is “sitting on an economic disaster”, recalled how his father’s assassination changed Sonia Gandhi, and made a remark about his mother “sitting on his father’s lap”, which provoked criticism. The BJP accused him of anti‑India propaganda, called him “India’s Mir Jafar”, and clashed with Congress over his comments on Sonia Gandhi’s affection. A Hindi‑language report said Amit Shah launched a political attack on Rahul Gandhi before the US trip, suggesting unrest among Gen Z voters. Rahul also responded to BJP critics with a “divine” retort to the “Mama on Papa’s lap” comment.
